payload.core_composition_summary: Iterative DP using set to accumulate all XOR subset sums, combined with bitwise XOR.
payload.rationale: Solution uses DP to maintain reachable XOR values (via set) and bitwise XOR to extend states. This is a composition of dynamic programming and bit manipulation.
